source.note: Wave-1 row 61 named the Quaternius Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs Stegosaurus on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is the same Quaternius dinosaur pack (Dec 2018) from its itch.io page, CC0, the same zip and pin as the t-rex and velociraptor. Height: 4 m to the top of the back plates in the rest pose, an adult Stegosaurus stenops (hips ~2.4 m); at that scale the model is 8.7 m long, within the 6.5-9 m adult range.
